name: image_validator
description: Image Validator — Next.js client and Express API on PostgreSQL

scripts.build: pnpm --filter server build && pnpm --filter client build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter server test && pnpm --filter client test
scripts.test:api:ci: concurrently --kill-others --success first "pnpm --filter server dev" "sleep 8 && pnpm --filter server run db:seed && pnpm test:api"
scripts.test:all: pnpm test && pnpm test:api:ci && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter server lint && pnpm --filter client lint
scripts.format: pnpm --filter server format && pnpm --filter client format
scripts.type-check: pnpm --filter server exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter client type-check
